name: Planner 5D
shortDescription: Turns an uploaded floor plan image into an editable 3D project. Premium is $19.99 a month.
longDescription: Planner 5D converts a plan image into an editable 3D project, then you furnish it and render it. AI floor plan recognition is included on Premium. The free plan is $0 and covers 2D and 3D design with half the catalog. Premium is $19.99 a month or $59.99 a year. Professional is $49.99 a month or $399.99 a year and adds watermark-free 4K renders.
pricingNotes: Free is $0. Premium is $19.99 per month or $59.99 per year and includes AI floor plan recognition. Professional is $49.99 per month or $399.99 per year.
freeTierNotes: Free plan with 2D and 3D design. AI floor plan recognition starts on Premium.
